component.name: Typeon
component.summary: Peer-to-peer encrypted messaging — linked desktop device

description.p: Typeon joins your existing Typeon account as a secondary device: it generates its own keys, shows a device-link QR code and is adopted by the primary (a phone). It cannot create or restore an account of its own: the phone stays the account's authority.

Every message is end-to-end encrypted with a hybrid post-quantum handshake and a double ratchet, and the local message archive is sealed in a file vault whose key lives in your system keyring — with an optional passphrase as a second factor. Reachability is deliberate: a Tor onion service by default, so devices behind CGNAT find each other.

ul.li: Direct and group chats, read receipts, edits, replies, reactions
Attachments, voice messages and a shared whiteboard
Optional store-and-forward servers for offline delivery and history
Multi-device linking, device verification and revocation

description.p: The desktop client is native GTK4 + libadwaita — the message protocol is the exact same core the Android app ships, linked in process.
Current release of the Linux desktop client.
